The hidden cost of AI rework
From containment to context: dynamic and attribute-based access
The citizen developer dilemma and agent sprawl
Executive buy-in for identity and access

takeaways: Copilot does not create new access; it inherits existing permissions and makes years of oversharing visible at machine speed.
Static, manual sensitivity labels both leave gaps and create silos, which drives AI rework; context-aware models like attribute-based access control evaluate who, where and why at request time.
Audit permission debt before scaling AI licenses, using Restricted SharePoint Search, mandatory auto-labeling and a site cleanup to close the biggest gaps.
hook: You rolled out Copilot and got a spike in DLP events and answers built on the wrong drafts instead of a productivity boost. This episode is for Microsoft 365 security and governance leads who need labels and permissions that work for AI. Learn how to move from static containment to context-aware access and where to start with Purview and Restricted SharePoint Search.
